results.description: the origin grid is inferred from a date suffix
results.detail: AssertionError: the runner derives its origin grid from a date suffix again; one quarterly series' release calendar would set the sampling grid, as it did when 344 origins appeared where 115 were planned

results.description: the assumed-lag check is removed from the panel builder
results.detail: AssertionError: the panel builder no longer checks that a revising series carries only publisher vintages; today's value under a historical release date would ship again

results.description: a kind-keyed dict keeps one series per kind
results.detail: BlockDefect: 4 live instrument(s) are declared and did not reach the model: ['CORCACBS', 'DGORDER', 'DRCCLACBS', 'U6RATE']. A block that silently loses a series produces a delta about a different feature set from the one the report names.

results.description: the ladder is scored once across every family
results.detail: AssertionError: the baseline ladder is scored once across every family; with base rates from 0.28 to 0.92 no single fit can represent them and the gate would measure the harness

results.description: the normalisation window is set to zero
results.detail: AssertionError: two episodes two months apart were accepted as separate events

results.description: percentage-point series lose their arithmetic difference
results.detail: AssertionError: the saving rate's change became undefined at a zero base; the series would silently leave the block again
AssertionError: a single-block sample returned an interval [+0.01500, +0.01500]; an episode-level verdict would be read off a row-level bootstrap

results.description: a preregistered H7 horizon is edited
results.detail: EconError: the H7 declaration changed: expected 3a5c4d36259e08a2, now e0fcc7d1e84e1c19. The targets, horizons and feature set were fixed before the V3 panel produced a number; editing them afterwards is break proof 8's mutation.

results.description: the causal-overreach check is removed from the verdict path
results.detail: AssertionError: the verdict path no longer checks that a temporal order is not being promoted to a predictive state; a lag of +6 months could carry a PROMOTE verdict on its own

results.description: the report stops validating its own text
results.detail: AssertionError: the V3 report no longer checks its own wording against the calibration status; a historical Brier could ship as accuracy

results.description: the Founder gate stops reading the verdicts
results.detail: AssertionError: Founder eligibility no longer derives from the construct verdicts; an unsupported signal would reach a company recommendation

results.description: the immutability check on the forward ledger is removed
results.detail: LedgerViolation: the ledger accepted a changed horizon on an existing expectation; the forward record is editable
